title: Locally Equienergetic Graphs
summary: For a given graph \( G \), let \( G^{(j)} \) denote the graph obtained by the deletion of vertex \( v_j \) from \( G \). The difference \( \mathscr{E}(G) - \mathscr{E}(G^{(j)}) \) quantifies the change in the energy of \( G \) upon the removal of \( v_j \), termed as the local energy of \( G \) at vertex $v_j$, as defined by Espinal and Rada in 2024. The local energy of $G$ at vertex $v$ is denoted by \(\mathscr{E}_G(v)\).
